bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
file="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
w="$root/.worktrees/issue7-room-migration-0651284"
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$root" || exit 71
test ! -e "$w" || exit 73
git -C "$root" fetch origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 74
git -C "$root" cat-file -e 0651284b609f8f7dd54ab09e14b4b62f3d0fc3db^{commit} || exit 75
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$w" 0651284b609f8f7dd54ab09e14b4b62f3d0fc3db >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 76
cleanup(){ git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$w" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; }
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$w"
docker build --network=host --pull=false --target build -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-build-0651284 . >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 51
docker run --rm --env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost:1/test --entrypoint sh gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-build-0651284 -c 'cd /src; pnpm --dir artifacts/bot run typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 61; cd artifacts/bot; pnpm exec tsx --test tests/roomCrossPost.test.ts tests/roomStagedEntry.test.ts tests/roomPublishedEditor.test.ts tests/roomLifecycle.test.ts tests/roomPostStatus.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62' || exit $?
docker build --network=host --pull=false -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-0651284 . >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 54
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-0651284 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 55
candidate=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:roommig-0651284) || exit 44
old=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1) || exit 43
test "$old" != "$candidate" || exit 45
current_hash=$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)
expected_hash=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" config --hash gaybbs | awk '{print $NF}')
test "$current_hash" = "$expected_hash" || exit 46
docker image tag "$old" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-roommig-0651284 || exit 47
docker image tag "$candidate" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 48
failure=63
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then failure=61
else
 i=0
 while test "$i" -lt 15; do
  if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != "$candidate" || test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != true; then failure=62; break; fi
  if docker logs --since 2m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519'; then
   if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != 0; then failure=64; break; fi
   found=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.room_join_links') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END" 2>/dev/null) || { failure=65; break; }
   if test "$found" = 1; then echo ROOM_JOIN_LINK_SCHEMA_LIVE_PASS; exit 0; fi
   failure=66; break
  fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 3
 done
fi
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-roommig-0651284 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 70
docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old" && test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 72
exit "$failure"
